data.news_availability_basis: BlockBeats newsflash add_time; historical first-receipt time unavailable
data.news_content_basis: Public newsflash API snapshot; historical content snapshots unavailable
data.model_method: Monthly walk-forward NanoJev financial choice head; each month's fit, selection, and calibration use only outcomes resolved before that month.
data.feature_method: shifted completed-minute volatility/trend features; no current-minute or future price input

events.source: BlockBeats public newsflash feed + ETHUSDT calibrated NanoJev choice head
events.score_semantics: p_breakout=p_up+p_down is a short-horizon direction-breakout proxy; it is not a profit or liquidation probability

signature_inputs.feature_method: shifted completed-minute volatility/trend features; no current-minute or future price input
